covers: The two registers of the MC6850 ACIA, selected by the RS pin

entries.name: status
entries.description: Status register: receiver, transmitter, modem pin and interrupt flags.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 7: RDRF, TDRE, DCD, CTS, FE, OVRN, PE, IRQ. FE and PE update per byte; IRQ follows the interrupt output; CTS follows the pin. DCD sets at a receive clock edge with the pin high and clears after the pin falls, a status read and a data read; TDRE reads 0 in reset or with CTS set.

entries.name: control
entries.description: Control register: clock divide, word format, transmit control, receive interrupt enable; divide code 11 is master reset, which clears the flags except CTS and sets TDRE.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0-1 divide the clock by 1, 16, 64, or 11 for master reset. Bits 2-4 pick 7E2, 7O2, 7E1, 7O1, 8N2, 8N1, 8E1, 8O1. Bits 5-6: 01 enables the transmit interrupt, 10 drives RTS high, 11 sends break, 00 none; bit 7 enables the receive interrupt.

entries.name: receive data
entries.description: Receive data register: the last complete received character.
entries.behaviour: Returns the byte, or its low 7 bits for a 7-bit word with parity. A read clears RDRF and OVRN, except the first read after an overrun, which sets OVRN and leaves RDRF. After a status read, a data read ends a DCD interrupt.

entries.name: transmit data
entries.description: Transmit data register: the next character to send.
entries.behaviour: Stores the byte and clears TDRE, replacing one not yet taken; ignored while in master reset. The transmitter takes it on a falling transmit clock edge when CTS is low, sets TDRE, and sends it low bit first.
